settings.title: Workspace Settings
settings.subtitle: Customize workflow, display, kanban columns, and data tools.
settings.discardChangesTitle: Discard unsaved changes and restore original settings
settings.cockpitStorage: Native storage in {{file}} with atomic synchronization.
settings.viewsDesc: Controls the default main view and the tabs displayed in the navigation header.
settings.methodologyDesc: Defines whether the project operates in continuous flow (Pure Kanban), by iterations (Scrum), or hybrid. Selecting Pure Kanban automatically hides Sprint options to streamline the interface.
settings.methodologyKanbanDesc: Continuous value flow without sprints. The board covers the entire backlog, hiding iteration tabs and fields.
settings.methodologyScrumDesc: Iteration-based management (Sprints) and prioritized backlog. No continuous board; primary hub is Sprint & Prioritization.
settings.methodologyScrumbanDesc: Fusion of Scrum and Kanban. Planning in Sprint & Prioritization and Kanban Board scoped to current Sprint Goal.
settings.defaultViewDesc: Select the screen that opens automatically when launching the app or switching projects.
settings.defaultViewKanbanDesc: Visual agile flow focused on active tasks, reviews, and day-to-day deployments.
settings.defaultViewSprintDesc: Bulk triage, estimation, sprint planning, and agile backlog grooming.
settings.defaultViewReleaseDesc: Management of releases to production, changelogs, and release notes.
settings.enabledTabsDesc: Customize visible tabs in header. Enable or disable any tab according to your team's needs.
settings.kanbanTabScrumbanDesc: Sprint Board: focused exclusively on tasks in active Sprint Goal
settings.kanbanTabScrumDesc: Kanban Board (disabled by default in pure Scrum; enable for visual board)
settings.kanbanTabKanbanDesc: Continuous board over the entire backlog (Draft, Doing, Review, Ready, Done)
settings.sprintTabKanbanDesc: Iteration planning (disabled by default in continuous Kanban)
settings.sprintTabScrumDesc: Iteration hub: estimation, prioritization, backlog grooming, and sprint goals
settings.releaseTabDesc: History of published releases and delivery notes
settings.modulesDesc: Enable or disable capabilities according to your team size and methodology. Selections persist immediately to .gripm/config.json and reflect reactively in the UI.
settings.moduleKanbanDesc: The core foundation of gripm: Markdown task management (backlog/tasks/), agile lifecycle (draft, doing, review, ready, done), quick filters, and high-performance visual boards.
settings.moduleSprintsDesc: Timebox iteration planning, dedicated Sprints tab, task-to-timebox assignment, sprint pickers in modals, and iteration filtering.
settings.moduleReleasesDesc: Formal version assembly from tasks certified in ready, changelog generation, semantic traceability, and production deploy promotion (done).
settings.moduleHubDesc: Allows connecting and switching between multiple repositories in a single centralized board, enabling the project switcher in the header and global registration in ~/.gripm/registry.json.
settings.kanbanColsDesc: Reorder, rename, define WIP limits, and map lifecycle statuses to columns.
settings.showIdeasDesc: Hidden by default to keep the board focused on active tasks.
settings.showDoneHistoryDesc: Closed tasks from past sprints are hidden by default to maximize performance and reduce visual clutter.
settings.assignedStatusesDesc: Any card with these statuses will group here
settings.taxonomyDesc: Administrative sovereignty: customize card taxonomy to suit your team's needs. Create new types (e.g. Spike, Infrastructure, Research), configure semantic color palettes, and visual icons.
settings.systemTypesDesc: Default base taxonomy provided by gripm. Always available in your filters and workflows.
settings.customTypesTitle: Custom Card Types for Your Project ({{count}})
settings.customTypesDesc: Custom defined types. Automatically integrate into item modals, filters, and Kanban badges.
settings.noCustomTypesHint: Use the form below to create your first custom type (e.g. spike, infra, research).
settings.typeFormDesc: Define the unique slug identifier, display name, semantic color palette, and visual icon.
settings.typeKeyHelp: Lowercase unique identifier (used in frontmatter and Markdown).
settings.typeVisibleHelp: Name displayed in modals, badges, and filters.
settings.typeDescPlaceholder: Brief purpose for this type to guide developers and AI agents...
settings.appearanceDesc: Adjust language, visual theme, typography density, and auto-save behaviors.
settings.languageDesc: Select your preferred language for all system views, modals, and controls.
settings.themeLightDesc: Designed for well-lit environments and soft contrasts.
settings.themeDarkDesc: Modern Linear-style aesthetic to reduce eye strain during long sessions.
settings.themeSystemDesc: Automatically matches your device's global appearance preference.
settings.densityDesc: Spacing and sizing of cards within columns.
settings.autoSaveDesc: Persist changes in real-time when editing task details.
settings.rankingLabel: Manual Ranking and Drag & Drop in Backlog
settings.rankingDesc: Allows dragging rows in Sprint & Prioritization to freely reorder tasks and set relative priorities.
settings.toolsDesc: Tools to import existing backlogs and generate backups of your tasks.
settings.importWizardDesc: Import task lists in plain text or Markdown (checklists - [ ], sprint headings, and priorities) and convert them to structured gripm cards.
settings.exportMdDesc: Download a single consolidated Markdown file with current status of all tasks to share or version in external repositories.
settings.exportJsonDesc: Download raw items structure, metadata, plans, and dependencies in native JSON for migration or cold restore.
settings.advancedDesc: Directly inspect and edit serialized project parameters.
